Oahu.text: House sales are up 6% and the median is up 4% to $1.19M. Condos are flat: sales −2%, median $512K.

Maui County.text: Buyers are back for condos, but at lower prices: condo sales are up 21% while the median fell 7% to $655K. Resort condos fell most: Wailea/Mākena −17%, Kapalua −16%, Kīhei −12%, Nāpili/Kahana −12%.

Kauai.text: Fewer sales (houses −8%, condos −21%), but the house median rose 11% to $1.30M, pulled up by Kōloa and Poʻipū (+47%). The mix shifted toward expensive homes.

Hawaii Island.text: Sales are flat island-wide (houses −1%, median $564K), but house dollar volume is up 18% because the top end grew: South Kohala +48% and North Kona +29%.
